Package com.im.njams.sdk.logmessage

Class JobActivities

  • java.lang.Object
    • com.im.njams.sdk.logmessage.JobActivities
  • public class JobActivities
extends Object
    Owns the runtime activities of a Job: the activity registry, lookups, and the start activity. Obtain via job.activities(). This facet is part of the runtime monitoring path.

    • Method Detail

      • add

        public void add​(Activity activity)
        Adds a new Activity to the Job. Unlike the deprecated Job.addActivity(Activity), activities may be added BEFORE the job is started — they are sent with the first log message after the job starts. If the activity is a start activity, but not the only one in this job, a NjamsSdkRuntimeException will be thrown.
        Parameters:
        activity - to add to this job.

      • create

        public ActivityBuilder create​(ActivityModel activityModel)
        Creates an ActivityBuilder for the given ActivityModel. Unlike the deprecated Job.createActivity(ActivityModel), the built activity may be added before the job is started.
        Parameters:
        activityModel - to create an activity for
        Returns:
        a builder
